Two `use:` directives with the same action, the same modifiers and the same argument on one element run the action twice.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/no-dupe-use-directives": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
<input use:autofocus use:autofocus />
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
<input use:autofocus use:tooltip={hint} />
```
